title: Scenario Presets — implementation
summary: Support reusable, named policy scenarios so users start from a coherent position rather than blank sliders. Provides scenarios.yaml, a validated loader, a UI selector and human-readable summaries. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: All seven initial scenarios load, validate and run without error
Selecting a scenario populates every lever and assumption deterministically
An invalid or missing scenario file fails clearly in the UI
Each scenario has a one-paragraph summary visible to users
notes:
Scope (in): scenarios.yaml describing each preset; Schema-validating scenario loader; Scenario selector in the UI; Human-readable scenario summaries; Scenario documentation; Initial set: Baseline, Fairness Swap, Social Investment, Deficit Repair, Universal Basic Services, UBI Experiment, Austerity Trap
Out of scope: User-created/saved scenarios (EPIC-004); Scoring of scenarios (EPIC-003); Sharing scenarios publicly (EPIC-006)
